T4–T5 switch skills to book a Hertz compact rental for Elena Brooks and begin Maya Chen's wireless-mouse shopping. T6 (the policy-recall probe) appends a LogiTech M310 note to customer_report.docx, correctly recalling that 'the mouse from earlier' is the M310. T7 is a dense parallel turn — human transfer, profile and flight lookups, Excel notation, the final-sale return check, lamp compatibility and a cart add — and T8–T9 confirm no return was submitted and recap. The agent threads working-memory recall cleanly across four skills and applies the final-sale/return rule correctly; the single-turn sprawl at T7 is its main audit risk.
